title: GTA 6 Launch: Chennai CEO Gives 26 Employees Holiday To Play Game
text:
No work, just GTA 6! Chennai startup founder Kishore Shanmugam has declared a holiday for his entire team of 26 employees to celebrate the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI on November 19, ending a 13-year wait since GTA 5.

Speaking to NDTV, Shanmugam explains why employee happiness matters more to him than losing a day's business. He also shares how he earned his first ₹50 by completing GTA missions for friends, why the game holds a special place in his childhood, and why employees won't have to worry about work calls during their gaming holiday.
